Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, driven by its strategic transformation into a value-added coated steel manufacturer and the commissioning of its Alu-Zinc coating line. Total revenues crossed the ₹1,000 Crore milestone for the first time, reaching ₹1,053.19 Crore, while EBITDA and Profit After Tax registered significant increases due to operating leverage and higher capacity utilisation. Management outlined robust forward guidance, including projected consolidated revenues of ₹1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and ₹3,000 Crore for FY 2028-29, backed by planned capacity expansions and a new cold-rolling mill. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its annual performance for FY 2024-25, noting a decrease in revenue and profitability alongside a 15% growth in sales tonnage. The company is undertaking major capital expansion programmes, including a new integrated Alu-Zinc production line and a color coating manufacturing line funded through internal accruals and earnings.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: A second expansion programme of H40 Crore will add a new colour coating manufacturing line to enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 due to a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme comprising a new colour coating line is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company is set to introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, during the year.
management_commitments.quote: The management is excited to introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, an alloy consisting of 55% Aluminium and 45% Zinc on cold rolled strip, during the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
